Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import json
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"description.txt","function":"<global>","line":1,"var":"vulnerability hypothesis","code":"Crash in assimp ASE importer during material handling","note":"The reported crash state points to ASE material processing, so the attacker-controlled input is an ASE file that drives importer material parsing."},
{"step":2,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/assimp/code/AssetLib/ASE/ASELoader.cpp","function":"ASEImporter::ConvertMeshes","line":924,"var":"mParser->m_vMaterials[mesh.iMaterialIndex].avSubMaterials","code":"if (!mParser->m_vMaterials[mesh.iMaterialIndex].avSubMaterials.empty()) {","note":"A mesh assigned to a material with submaterials enters the split-mesh path, which copies the submaterial vector for later use."},
{"step":3,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/assimp/code/AssetLib/ASE/ASELoader.cpp","function":"ASEImporter::ConvertMeshes","line":925,"var":"vSubMaterials","code":"std::vector<ASE::Material> vSubMaterials = mParser->m_vMaterials[mesh.iMaterialIndex].avSubMaterials;","note":"Copying the submaterial vector invokes ASE::Material move/copy behavior on nested materials, matching the crash state in std::__1::__construct_backward_with_exception_guarantees."},
{"step":4,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/assimp/code/AssetLib/ASE/ASEParser.h","function":"ASE::Material","line":86,"var":"avSubMaterials","code":"avSubMaterials = other.avSubMaterials;","note":"ASE::Material assignment copies the nested vector directly, so malformed nested material state propagates into the copied vector during construction/assignment."},
{"step":5,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/assimp/code/AssetLib/ASE/ASEParser.h","function":"ASE::Material","line":96,"var":"avSubMaterials","code":"avSubMaterials(std::move(other.avSubMaterials)),","note":"The move constructor also transfers the nested vector, so the importer relies on vector element construction of nested ASE::Material objects."},
{"step":6,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/assimp/code/AssetLib/ASE/ASELoader.cpp","function":"ASEImporter::BuildMaterialIndices","line":1199,"var":"mat.avSubMaterials","code":"for (unsigned int iSubMat = 0; iSubMat < mat.avSubMaterials.size(); ++iSubMat) {","note":"Later, the importer iterates the same nested submaterial list to convert and index materials, confirming that attacker-controlled submaterial counts and nesting affect material construction paths."},
{"step":7,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/assimp/code/AssetLib/ASE/ASELoader.cpp","function":"ASEImporter::BuildMaterialIndices","line":1200,"var":"submat","code":"ASE::Material &submat = mat.avSubMaterials[iSubMat];","note":"Each nested material is accessed by reference and may be converted into an output aiMaterial, so a malformed nested material can reach the sink through this path."},
{"step":8,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/assimp/code/AssetLib/ASE/ASELoader.cpp","function":"ASEImporter::ConvertMaterial","line":807,"var":"mat.pcInstance","code":"mat.pcInstance = new aiMaterial();","note":"Material conversion allocates output material objects after the nested material structure has been built, making the earlier vector construction the root cause rather than the sink itself."}
]
print(json.dumps(trace, indent=2))
PY
